text.p: These are significant stories in the Nigerian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Five persons confirmed dead in crash landing of a 16-seater plane belonging to privately owned Skypower Express at Yola airport in northeastern Nigeria.
- Southwestern Nigeria zone of customs department generates a whopping revenue of 7.4 billion naira for 1996, says zonal coordinator Joseph Ohiotse.
- U.S. government in its annual human rights report, expresses concern over detention of political opponents in Nigeria and faults on-going transition to democracy programme.
- Stock exchange holds a 30-minute mock session in honour of its deputy director general Chief Henry Ogirri, who died in a car accident on January 14.
